exact: fibroblast growth factor receptor signalling pathway involved in mammary gland specification

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by binding of a fibroblast growth factor to its receptor on the surface of al cell in the epidermis resulting in the formation of the mammary line. The mammary line is a ridge of epidermal cells that will form the mammary placodes.
label: fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway involved in mammary gland specification
